**Root cause of the bug:** `parse_amount` did `float(text)` inside a `try` whose `except ValueError` returned `0.0`. `"12,000.00"` fails `float()` because of the comma, so it silently became `0.0` — giving `45.50 + 0 + 0 + 45.50 = 91.00`. The same `except` also swallowed genuinely garbage amounts as `0.0`. Fixed by stripping `,` (the module docstring already promised `1,250.00` parses) and raising on anything still unparseable. `2026-08` now reports **13341.0**.
